artifacts.title: Congregational consent requirement for calling assistant pastors under BCO 22
artifacts.disposition: ambiguous (does not address treatment of current Assistant Pastors upon adoption); Adopted 7-0-1

matches.evidence: The CCB found the proposed amendment affirming congregational consent for assistant pastors ambiguous, as it did not address how current assistant pastors would be treated upon adoption.

artifacts.title: Process for converting assistant pastor to associate pastor

matches.evidence: The CCB found that amending BCO 22 to clarify the process for an assistant pastor becoming an associate pastor was not in conflict with the BCO, and the overture was adopted.
